nodes.label: Popup Page (chrome-mv3-dev, Vite dev server)
nodes.rationale: Dev build injects WXT/Vite HMR scripts (virtual:wxt-inline-script, @vite/client) for live reload; mirrors prod popup structure

nodes.label: Popup Page (chrome-mv3 production build)
nodes.rationale: Prod build is hashed asset bundle (popup-CcPWwewQ.js, popup-CAbGx5cX.css) without dev HMR, ready for MV3 load unpacked

nodes.label: Shared ESLint Config (@workspace/eslint-config)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes lint rules across Turborepo workspaces to ensure consistent code style without duplicating config

nodes.label: Registry Layout Contract (universities/<uni>/meta.json, majors/<major>/meta.json)
nodes.rationale: Layout is contract - never hand-build paths (use src/paths.ts), slugs permanent with azad-/gov-/pnu- prefix, charts/<degree>/meta.json required; prevents drift between file system and DB slug references

nodes.label: Year Directory Detector (parseYearDirectory/formatYearDirectory)
nodes.rationale: Supports both range [1403-1404] and single 1405 forms, no max span, reversed rejected - allows cohort-based chart versioning

nodes.label: Chart Degree Meta (termCount/maxTermCount)
nodes.rationale: Both termCount (standard 8) and maxTermCount (with سنوات e.g. 14) required, no default, authoritative for setup page سنوات مجاز display; validator does not cap

nodes.label: Index Builder (build-index -> registry/index/*.json)
nodes.rationale: Generated index never hand-edited, never walked at runtime; API reads via readIndexes() for serverless friendliness, fans out BOTH -> MEHR/BAHMAN

nodes.label: Registry Single Source of Truth (git JSON, validated by CI, no DB FK)
nodes.rationale: All universities/majors/charts/offerings/professors/archives/groups live as JSON under packages/registry/registry, contributed via PRs, validated by CI; DB rows store slugs only for loosly-coupled reference
nodes.norm_label: registry single source of truth (git json, validated by ci, no db fk)

nodes.label: Course Offerings Snapshot (courses/<year>/<semester>/new.json -> old.json/diff.json)
nodes.rationale: Extension writes only new.json; CI rotates to old.json on merge and generates diff.json keyed by offering index; API diffs for resumable notifications

nodes.label: Professors Auto-Generated (prof-<n> slugs, append-only)
nodes.rationale: scripts/sync-professors.ts appends unique sequential prof-<n> slugs from new.json professor names, never removes/renames - DB votes reference stable slugs

nodes.label: Shared TypeScript Config (@workspace/typescript-config)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes TS compiler options across workspaces, same sharing pattern as eslint-config

nodes.label: Curriculum Chart PDF 1402 BOTH (bachelors-degree, 5 pages, 148KB)
nodes.rationale: Visual chart sits beside both.json for دريافت چارت; API GET /me/chart-file falls back mehr.pdf -> both.pdf for MEHR/BAHMAN cohorts

nodes.label: Curriculum Chart PDF [1400-1401] BOTH (identical to 1402, 148KB, created 20240912)
nodes.norm_label: curriculum chart pdf [1400-1401] both (identical to 1402, 148kb, created 20240912)

nodes.label: Curriculum Chart PDF [1403-1405] BOTH (updated, 5 pages, 130KB, created 20241225)
